problem_statement: When wildcard resources are enabled, the HTTP server resolves a request by trying the wildcard (fnmatch) match before checking exact path matches. As a result, a filesystem resource registered at a parent path (for example /testfs) incorrectly captures a request for a child path (for example /testfs/static) and serves from the filesystem, instead of an explicitly-defined resource registered at that exact child path. An exact-path resource must always take preference over a filesystem/wildcard resource, so a request to /testfs/static should be served by the static resource registered at /testfs/static, while a request to a file under /testfs (for example /testfs/test_file) should still be served from the filesystem.
